description: This source file defines the SimpleGenerator class, which implements the IStreamGenerator interface to generate a single stream of configurable events, one per poll, for Orleans streaming tests.

classes.name: SimpleGenerator
classes.description: Implements a stream generator that produces a single stream of events, with configurable number of events, for Orleans streaming tests.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the generator with provided service provider and generator configuration, initializing stream ID and sequence ID.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to generate and return up to maxCount events, producing a single event per call until the configured number of events is reached.

methods.name: TryGenerateBatch
methods.description: Generates a single batch of event, marking it as the last if it reaches the total configured events.
